thread:
sara_cs: billing-bot flagged a commit delta for Orchid Labs — hosted usage is 3.6x their monthly commit in the last 6h, rolling alert fired. anyone on this account?

billing-bot: ALERT: orchid-labs (acct_ore-112) usage 3.6x vs commit threshold. Project: prod-api. Top contributors: text-gen (94%), embeddings (4%), misc (2%). Link: https://billing/reports/acct_ore-112 (auto)

matt_se: pinging onboarding + eng. Sara — do we know if they just ramped workloads or this looks anomalous vs historical pattern?

sara_cs: historically flat 0.8–1.1x. No usage change in last weekly check-in. They were onboarding two product teams last week but we didn't see this spike then.

elaine_data: quick query shows a token surge from eu-west-1 starting 03:10 UTC. 6h window: tokens = 18.2M vs baseline 4.9M. Top path: /v1/chat/completions with avg prompt length up 2.3x.

ryan_eng: could be retry amplification. Our telemetry shows 429s for that project spiking at 03:08–03:15 UTC (brief). If clients retried aggressively with backoff disabled, tokens could balloon.

jenny_enablement: I'll check outreach — are they using our official SDK or a custom client? that affects retry behavior.

matt_se: @ryan_eng can you dump request logs for sample keys? I want timestamps + status codes. also check if any SDK version mismatch (old sdk had no jitter on retries).

ryan_eng: grabbing logs now. sample:```
2026-03-18T03:09:12Z acct_ore-112 key=k-us-east1 path=/v1/chat/completions status=200 tokens=1245 latency_ms=190
2026-03-18T03:09:13Z acct_ore-112 key=k-us-east1 path=/v1/chat/completions status=429 tokens=0 latency_ms=42
2026-03-18T03:09:14Z acct_ore-112 key=k-us-east1 path=/v1/chat/completions status=200 tokens=1245 latency_ms=180
```

elaine_data: correlating — those 429s line up with a client retry burst. I see many identical prompt hashes repeated within seconds. suggests client replaying same request without exponential backoff.

sara_cs: action items: 1) billing alert to customer (hold for 30m while we validate), 2) reach out to Orchids' eng PM to confirm SDK, 3) recommend short-term quota cap to limit further burn, 4) follow-up with engineering root cause.

matt_se: I can draft the outbound note. propose wording: "we noticed a temporary spike tied to retry behavior causing unexpected token usage — we'll pause/limit and help adjust your client retry config." ok?

jenny_enablement: please include steps: check SDK >= v1.4.2, enable jitter/backoff, and consider client-side dedupe. I'll attach a snippet.

jenny_enablement: snippet:```js
// recommended retry (node)
const client = new RedwoodClient({...});
await client.request(path, { retries: 3, backoff: { type: 'exponential', jitter: true } });
```

billing-bot: TEMP_ACTION: quota cap applied to acct_ore-112 project prod-api — hard cap 100k reqs / 24h. Admin: sara_cs.

ryan_eng: we've isolated a transient routing issue in eu-west-1 that returned 429s from a single proxy fleet for ~7m. We'll put a mitigation to failover earlier and add a spike detector to avoid repeat.

elaine_data: post-mitigation numbers look good — tokens trending back to baseline in the last 30m. I ran a cost projection; if repeated for 24h we'd hit ~4.8x monthly commit. current one-off looks contained.

sara_cs: great. I'll send a calm FYI to Orchid (copying mitigation + recommended SDK config). we'll keep the quota cap active for 24h and re-evaluate. thanks all. :thumbsup:

matt_se: draft ready, sending in 5. includes offer for a screenshare to walk SDK changes.

jenny_enablement: i'll prepare a short how-to and sample PR we can share in the thread with Orchids' eng.

sara_cs: leaving note: follow-up to schedule check-in next week to confirm no residual drift and offer cost-optimization tips (caching, batching).
